forbidden: relaxing a frozen margin after seeing the result
weakening or removing a strong baseline because it wins
turning CANNOT_CHECK or transport failure into zero or PASS
changing gold or evaluator because the system failed
rewriting V1 protocol or results in place
treating a larger N as a mechanism repair when the observed failure is upstream and near-total
calling implementation novelty scientific novelty without external evidence
allowed: create a new immutable V2/V3 after diagnosing the V1 failure
build a fresh holdout after the new mechanism is frozen
add a stronger baseline as secondary pressure
shrink or reframe a claim when evidence is narrower than intended
end a revival as REFUTED when the repair does not work

rules.requirement: Attribute the observed failure to exactly one earliest causal stage before designing a repair. Diffuse labels such as model weakness are not discriminators.
Write the discriminator and its expected observations while competing causes remain live, before the candidate repair is evaluated.
Bind subject, data, splits, provider, model, baselines, budgets, evaluator, statistics and plots in a new protocol version before final outcomes. The old protocol remains immutable.
Every rejected, harmful or null candidate stays content-addressed and available for recurrence analysis. Negative evolution history is not deleted when a later protocol succeeds.
